stage.name: The Boat Home
stage.description:
'One boat for the people, the other for the scriptures. The faithful cerulean lotuses will lead the mahasattva of the Anasa home.'
Choose a foe and fight. Losing will not deduct Life Points. Defeating a tougher foe within the given time grants a better reward
stage.source: mode level file; no stage_table row

monster_mk_ii.name: Monster Mk II
monster_mk_ii.flavourText: An unmanned enemy drone that has been upgraded from its namesake model, the Monster MkII. Equipped with a small gun and a long-range Arts receiver, they are likely operated by concealed Casters. Though unlikely to cause heavy damage to armored Operators, they can still pose a considerable threat.

arts_master_a1.name: Arts Master A1
arts_master_a1.flavourText: An unmanned enemy drone with extremely high movement speed, modified from the product of an Arts Education competition. It is equipped with an Arts Weapon module that allows it to launch long-range Arts attacks, so proceed with caution. Based on available data, its weapon module also allows it to block some Arts damage.

defender_4.name: Defender-4
defender_4.flavourText: An unmanned enemy drone known as the Defender-4. Though they do not have any offensive capabilities, they must be taken care of due to their ability to support enemy troops.
abilities: Increases the DEF of surrounding enemy units

padmasana_of_rebirth.name: Padmasana of Rebirth
padmasana_of_rebirth.flavourText: It has no bottom yet never leaks, ferrying passengers from all lands to greener pastures atop a bed of cerulean flames. Only the freed may board this ark.
abilities: Loads up to 3 allied Operators upon contact. Movement speed is reduced when loaded.
Will not deduct Life Points when entering the Objective Point; loaded allied Operators cannot be placed on the field

decaying_collector_disciple.name: Decaying Collector Disciple
decaying_collector_disciple.flavourText: An organic construct containing the Nachzehrer King's Originium Arts. It can extract all kinds of dead souls from the battlefield to create Seeds of Decay.

imperial_artillery_targeteer.name: Imperial Artillery Targeteer
imperial_artillery_targeteer.flavourText: A heavily-armored, sturdily-built drone operated by artillery casters of the Ursus army. They presage the withering firepower of the Ursus Artillery.

raptor.name: Raptor
raptor.flavourText: An unmanned enemy drone, its design and name seem to be inspired by a certain space game. Equipped with a minigun and a long-range Arts receiver, they are likely operated by concealed Casters. Their outstanding stealthiness and attack power pose a major threat to Operators.

bombtail.name: Bombtail
bombtail.flavourText: An unmanned enemy drone that flies slowly. They carry an explosive warhead that is launched when approaching nearby Operators, inflicting physical damage in an area. Their design seems to have been inspired by a fantasy creature. Though they cannot attack anymore after launching the warhead, their movement speed increases afterwards due to the loss of weight.
abilities: Can launch a warhead to deal AoE physical damage
Gains significantly increased Movement Speed after launching warhead

frost.name: Frost
frost.flavourText: An unmanned enemy drone equipped with heavy armor to make it harder to destroy. Its prototype was designed by a graphics engine studio. They are equipped with a special device that allows them to drastically reduce the temperature around them, greatly decreasing the attack speed of nearby Operators.
abilities: All friendly units within range have reduced ASPD

oneiros.name: Oneiros
oneiros.flavourText: An unmanned, slow-flying enemy drone equipped with a special warhead released upon approaching Operators that inflicts Arts damage and a freezing effect in an area. Modified from the Bombtail, they lost their ability to accelerate after delivering the payload in order to accomodate a special warhead.
abilities: Can launch a warhead to deal AoE Arts damage and apply the Cold effect to targets
